name: Cisterna di Latina (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cisterna di Latina (three towers on green) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Cisterna di Latina, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 14 April 1938.

features.role: Cisterna di Latina arms — three towers on green, crowned, within branches
